title: Reviewed record that a geographic unit has no associated representative (PROPOSED, schema version 1)
description: One record asserts exactly one thing about exactly one unit: that no representative is associated with it, on the authority of a cited source, from an effective date, after review. It is the only thing that may turn a unit white. A missing row, a vacant marker, a failed name match or a browser-local log is never a record. No record exists yet; this schema is a proposal awaiting approval.

recordId.description: Stable ID of the record itself, never reused. Superseding a record means adding a new one that names this ID in `supersedes`; a record is not edited once approved.

supersedes.description: The recordId this record replaces, if any.

unit.description: The unit the record is about. All three fields must agree with the unit in the generated dataset, or the record is ignored.

id.description: The app's stable feature ID for the unit (derived from the official LGD code).

lgdCode.description: The official Local Government Directory code of the unit.

assertion.description: The only assertion a record can make. It is not 'vacant', not 'unallocated' and not 'unknown'.

kind.description: What sort of source this is, for example a signed register, a written confirmation from the responsible manager, or an approved master list.

reference.description: Title, document number or message identifier that a reviewer can find again.

location.description: Where in the source: sheet and row, page and line, paragraph.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source file as read, when it is a file. Strongly recommended.

provenance.description: Who put the record into the repository, and when. Not the reviewer.

effectiveDate.description: The date from which the assertion holds (YYYY-MM-DD). A record whose date is in the future is not yet in force and does not turn a unit white.

review.description: Only status 'approved', with a named reviewer and a review date, counts. 'pending', 'rejected' and 'superseded' never do.

reviewedBy.description: Required (non-empty) for 'approved'. Should be a different person from `provenance.recordedBy`.
